notes_for_editor: Unresolved date conflict: the register says built September 1939, but a December 1934 newspaper item says the Squirrel Hill tower was unused. Either the date is wrong or an earlier tower stood on the hill; the sources checked do not say which. Needs the Wisconsin Historical Society inventory or DNR records. No staffing, fire, or access sources found. Search results for Squirrel Hill mostly returned the Winter Park pavilion and tubing hill, not the tower, and were not used. A USDA Forest Service PDF named in a search snippet returned 404 and was not used. Elevation: the register gives 1,730 ft for the site, Wikipedia 1,735 ft for the hill.
